movement_profile.formation_and_space: Geometric floor patterns, intricate turns, sinuosities, interlacings, confrontations, and retreats viewed from three sides overhead.
movement_profile.partnering: Dancers alternate by turns during thematic entrées, unite in the Grand Ballet, and partner with the courtly audience in the closing social ball.

signature_moves.description: Floor-level configurations of circles, squares, and lines designed to be interpreted from overhead galleries.
signature_moves.name: Figure geometric patterns

signature_moves.description: Thematic movement sequences performed by specific characters or courtier groups matching dramatic acts.
signature_moves.name: Entrée

signature_moves.description: The culminating apothéose uniting all dancers in collective geometric choreography.
signature_moves.name: Grand Ballet

music_profile.musical_form: Overture with dramatic recitation followed by thematic entrées and a grand finale
music_profile.sound_description: A grand theatrical tapestry alternating dramatic spoken recitations and sung airs with instrumental violin ensembles. The music structures dramatic acts called entrées, supporting intricate spatial choreographies and culminating in sweeping celebratory full-cast finales.
music_profile.vocal_style: Spoken recitation, sung recitative, vocal airs, and choruses

teaching.formation: Geometric spatial patterns designed to be viewed from above, progressing from sectional entrées to a full ensemble Grand Ballet.
teaching.level_notes: Originally performed by noble courtiers and select professionals; requires mastery of group geometry, floor formations, and aristocratic deportment.
